goal:
We are checking a historical structure before using its reported compactness as a classroom example. Can the model-1 C-alpha radius of gyration in the supplied deposition be described as covering the entire declared single polypeptide chain? Give the measurement in angstroms, the counted residues and the declared denominator; also check whether N, CA, C and O are represented at each position. A complete-chain label requires all declared positions to have these four backbone atoms. If a position is missing, state the scope of the measurement. Keep crystallographic and solution claims distinct.

Please run the coordinate analysis on the original. In parallel, have one researcher examine what the archived experimental record can support and a different researcher examine the scope and limits of the proposed numerical interpretation. Have them return their own signed reasons; use their reports as appropriate when you decide. If your calculation and readout are suitable for a second independent entry, publish the executed measurement as a reusable workspace recipe before closing, with a question for the future Lead to answer about its own result.

operation.reason: Report a whole-chain model-1 Cα radius for ubiquitin chain A. The original coordinate readout supplies the radius and denominator, and the two signed reviews establish residue coverage and crystallographic scope. The published workspace recipe single-chain-backbone-coverage-rg@1 asks a future Lead to compare both the Cα count and the complete-backbone count with the new entry's own declared length before labeling its radius.
unresolved: Solution compactness and between-sample variation remain unmeasured. A solution radius requires solution data under stated conditions.

final_decision.rationale: The executed analysis of the original 1UBQ coordinates gives {{metric:ca_radius_of_gyration_A}} for {{metric:ca_count}} equally weighted Cα sites. Chain A has {{metric:declared_residues}} declared residues and {{metric:complete_backbones}} positions with N, CA, C and O. The numerical researcher matched each position from Met1 through Gly76 and confirmed that the partially occupied tail sites each contribute once. The archive researcher verified the X-ray method and showed that the completeness fields describe diffraction reflections. Both records concern the same deposition. The position-by-position coordinate check supports the whole-chain label for this crystal model.
